basic_info.description: Indulge and experience the best of the city, where urban vibrancy, suburban charm, and seaside splendor intertwine. Just moments from Ocean Beach, this beautifully updated 3BR/2BA residence (the lower-level en-suite bath is unpermitted) captivates with unobstructed ocean views and the soothing sound of waves crashing in the distance. Natural light pours gracefully through voluminous windows, artfully incorporating the outdoors within and accentuating the soft neutral color palette, refined moldings, and engineered flooring. Upstairs, an inviting living room flows seamlessly into the dining area and kitchen, appointed with a gas range and stainless steel appliances. Two generously sized bedrooms and a full bathroom complete the main level. Designed for supreme versatility and privacy, the lower level boasts a secluded third bedroom with its own en-suite bathroom. Step outside and enjoy the fresh sea breeze from the expansive backyard, ideal for effortless entertaining. This residence also features fresh interior paint, refreshed bathrooms, and a two-car tandem garage. Ideally situated near charming boutiques, dining, city landmarks, public transit, and convenient to commute routes, makes this a remarkable offering!
